categories.main_business_segments: Kinco Automation primarily operates in industrial automation and robotics, focusing on core components and digital factory software and hardware. Key segments include robot industry solutions (industrial mobile robots, collaborative robots, service robots), medical imaging equipment, machine IoT, and general automation products such as servo systems, stepper systems, PLCs, and inverters.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops advanced technologies including embedded industrial human-machine interfaces (HMI), servo drive and motor systems, integrated servo modules, programmable logic controllers (PLC), and low-voltage inverters. It emphasizes integrated mechatronics, modular design, and proprietary algorithms for precise motion control, electromagnetic optimization, and IoT connectivity. Production combines in-house assembly, testing, and software programming with outsourced PCB assembly.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kinco serves industrial automation equipment manufacturers across robotics, medical imaging, new energy (lithium battery, photovoltaic), logistics, packaging, 3C electronics, and automotive sectors. Its customers include global leaders in industrial robots, medical devices, and smart manufacturing, with a focus on strategic industry clients and expanding overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Shenzhen, Chengdu, and Changzhou. It has expanded its global footprint through partnerships and sales in Europe, the US, India, and Southeast Asia, actively participating in international trade shows and building overseas sales and service networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kinco operates mainly in the midstream segment of the industrial automation supply chain, manufacturing core control and drive components such as HMIs, servo motors, drives, PLCs, and inverters. It supplies these components and integrated solutions to downstream equipment manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in integrated servo systems, IoT-enabled HMIs, advanced PLCs, and digital factory solutions. It focuses on innovation in low-voltage servo drives for mobile robots, high power density frameless motors for collaborative robots, and modular servo products. Kinco invests heavily in patent development and software platform upgrades to enhance automation and digitalization capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of industrial automation components and systems, including servo drives, motors, HMIs, PLCs, and inverters. The company also earns income from software licensing, technical services, and digital factory solutions. Sales are conducted via direct sales to strategic customers and through a network of distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kinco is a leading domestic player in China's industrial automation control market, especially in low-voltage servo drives for mobile robots where it holds a dominant market share. It competes with international giants like Siemens and Schneider, as well as strong domestic competitors such as Inovance. Kinco differentiates itself through integrated solutions, innovation, and cost competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Kinco reported revenue of approximately RMB 547 million, an 8.09% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 48.9 million, a 19.43% decrease. The company maintains steady asset growth and invests over 13% of revenue in R&D. It has a workforce of over 700 employees, including nearly 200 R&D personnel, supporting sustained growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kinco emphasizes high-quality, low-cost, and innovative automation and digital solutions tailored to strategic industries. Its integrated servo modules, advanced embedded HMI platforms, and comprehensive industrial automation product lines provide customers with enhanced efficiency, reliability, and scalability. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and close customer collaboration enable rapid customization and support for emerging applications in robotics and smart manufacturing.
